title: bupleurum paniculatum var. acutifolium
intro: Bupleurum paniculatum var. acutifolium, commonly known as Chinese Thorny Bupleurum, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae, traditionally used in Chinese medicine. It is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, headache, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum paniculatum var. acutifolium include its ability to clear heat, relieve toxic-heat symptoms, and calm the mind and spirit. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saikosaponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
